name: Habit Tracker · Year in Pixels
note: A 12 × 31 year-in-pixels grid with roving-tabindex arrow keys, where every streak is a rail joining its days and checking today sends a staggered ripple back through it. The habit's colour is a registered <color> @property, so switching habits cross-fades every cell, and streak counts roll through an integer @property counter. Set --aph-habits-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Meal Planner · Week to Shopping List
note: Drag recipes onto a seven-day board (or pick one and tap a slot); the shopping list is a pure function of the plan. Ingredients merge across recipes, scale by servings and batch leftovers, round up to what a shop sells, and the list reflows with FLIP on the Web Animations API while new lines enter through @starting-style. Set --aph-meals-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Running Plan · Goal-Driven Paces
note: A 12-week half-marathon plan where the goal time is the single input: every zone pace, segment split, weekly total and race prediction is derived from it. Pace digits animate through a registered integer @property that CSS splits into minutes and seconds with round() and mod(), with a plain-text fallback behind @supports. Set --aph-run-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Sleep Diary · 24-Hour Dial
note: Bedtime and wake are two role="slider" handles on an SVG 24-hour dial (drag them, or use the arrow keys and Page Up/Down); every edit is a per-night draft until saved. The insights rail is derived from the diary itself: a sleep-window chart for consistency and a with/without comparison per tag that also filters the list. Set --aph-sleep-h to 100dvh in an app.
